profile.headline: Mechanic, software developer and animator
profile.summary:
Automotive experience on VinWiki: web.vinwiki.com/#/person/04d52d9b-3bbf-4580-b187-b14f28632d50

Currently working as a software developer at AMI Strategies.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software developer on AMI's Development team. Currently focused on PDF database translation and management.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Science · C (Programming Language) · C++ · C# · SQL

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
 Full-stack development position for Dr. Heckman (BGSU Biology professor)
 Modification of existing code files to operate in a server-based UNIX environment
 Self-regulated documentation of code files for future program modifications

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Sales associate and driver for Autozone. A friendly and professional environment where I commonly converse with both seasoned veterans of the industry and total novices who just need some oil for a family member. Communication is king, and what knowledge you have is second only to how you find something you don't know.

positions.title: General Service Mechanic
positions.description: Mechanic at several Tireman locations. A fast-paced and highly demanding job, both physically and mentally- especially during the school year! This job taught me about commercial safety, work environments, and communication. It also turned my fascination with cars into something of an area of expertise.
